edition_scope: Lords of Vegas Mayfair base game (2010/2013 English rulebook), 2–4 players, four-page Mayfair rulebook hosted by Lone Shark. Complete base rules, all action, payout, boss/tie, trade and scoring-track/end branches. Exclude Up!, Underworld, Americana, Con Jobs and revised six-player edition.
method: PyMuPDF native page rendering at2x; original PDF unchanged. Navigation/visual inspection aid, not an additional rule source.

scope_notes.two_player: Printed standard2-player F-block procedure is part of the advertised2-4-player base scope, not an expansion to silently exclude.
scope_notes.gamble_variant: The separate optional Gamble Variant may be explicitly excluded.
scope_notes.diagrams: Scoring break examples span pages2/3; reorganization example spans3/4; tied-boss cascade is shown on4. Native diagrams must be consulted when extraction is insufficient.
